summary: Comprehensive production-readiness implementation plan for Atrium ERP & CRM. Details the 6 critical operational upgrades required for commercial production grade: returning user boot lifecycle (bypassing onboarding on reload), complete disaster recovery backup (1-click JSON export and restore), top bar breadcrumb alignment across all verticals (including Education & Retail), universal @media print stylesheet perfection for invoices and certificates, defensive form validation with tactile toast alerts, and a global Command Palette (Ctrl+K) for instant multi-record search.
